description: Defines an internal interface IConnectedClientCollection for managing a collection of connected clients in Orleans runtime, along with a sealed class EmptyConnectedClientCollection as an implementation returning an empty client list.

classes.name: EmptyConnectedClientCollection
classes.description: A sealed class implementing IConnectedClientCollection that represents an empty collection with a version fixed at 0.

methods.name: Version
methods.description: Property returning the version number of the collection, always 0 in this implementation.

methods.name: GetConnectedClientIds
methods.description: Returns a new empty list of GrainId representing no connected clients.
